---
title: "My Toolkit"
listing: default
description: "Some web-based mini tools developed by me."

title-block-banner: "#373a3c"

# Add blog-post class to the banner header area
format: 
  html:
    code-tools: false
    quarto-template-params:
      banner-header-class: "blog-post"
      
---


<style>
  /* Reset the container to take up the full width */
header#title-block-header .quarto-title.column-page-left {
  grid-column: screen-start / screen-end !important;
  max-width: 100%;
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center; /* Centers items horizontally */
  justify-content: center;
}

/* Ensure the banner itself allows for centering */
.quarto-title-banner {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 100%;
}

/* Force text alignment just in case */
.quarto-title h1.title, 
.quarto-title .description {
  text-align: center;
}

</style>
